audit.whatIsWrong: Four level rows disagreed with the packet chart: Level 1 and Levels 4-5 said Skill where the packet gives Olaf and the prose says Olaf wins, and first item and 2+ items said Olaf where the packet says Skill and Sylas.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page named no Sylas ability (packet defect), said Chain Lash 'heals him on the second hit', and repeatedly called Abscond/Abduct a stun.
audit.why: The heal is on Kingslayer (W), not Chain Lash — the page told the reader to fear the wrong ability for the wrong reason. Chain Lash is a cross whose intersection explodes on a delay. The other unstated fact is that Sylas carries TWO dashes — Kingslayer's lunge and Abscond, with Abduct recasting into a chain pull — so the trade window is the 13s after Abscond is spent, not 'after his stun'.
audit.corrected: Named Petricite Burst, Chain Lash, Kingslayer, Abscond/Abduct and Hijack (80/55/30s); moved the heal to Kingslayer; keyed the trading advice to Abscond's 13s cooldown; removed the unverifiable stun claims.

edits.before: Sylas is also melee, so you actually get to fight - this isn't a kiter lane. Land your Q to slow him and walk him down; at 2-3 your E true damage burst beats anything his W drain heals back. Watch his E - it's a two-part chain dash that stuns, so bait it out before you all-in, because if he lands it he peels your commit. His Q is a double-cast cone that heals him on the second hit, so don't sit in it while he ramps sustain.
edits.after: Sylas is also melee, so you actually get to fight - this isn't a kiter lane. Land your Q to slow him and walk him down; at 2-3 your E true damage burst beats anything Kingslayer heals back. He carries two dashes - Kingslayer's lunge and Abscond, which recasts into a chain pull - so bait one out before you commit, because Abscond is 13s at rank 1. Chain Lash's cross explodes on a delay, so step off the intersection.

edits.before: You're still favored through 4-5 - axe-reset slows plus W omnivamp out-grind his rotations. But level 6 flips: his R steals YOUR Ragnarok, handing him a CC-immunity all-in or a clean escape from your dive, so respect that he now has your best tool. Don't ult into him expecting to be unstoppable - he can answer with your own kit. Fight when his E and stolen-R are down.
edits.after: You're still favored through 4-5 - axe resets plus Tough It Out's shield out-grind his rotations. But level 6 flips: Hijack steals YOUR Ragnarok on an 80s cooldown at rank 1, handing him a disable-immune all-in or a clean escape from your dive. Don't ult in expecting to be unstoppable - he can answer with your own kit. Fight when Abscond and the stolen R are down.

Convert your early lead into towers, plates and dives before two items land - if it goes long, he wins the extended fight and turns your own ult against you.

notes: Olaf's Undertow is flagged 'grounding' in the kit file only because Riot's text says the axe lands in the ground; it is a parsing artifact, so no grounding-denies-his-dashes advice was written here. The page asserted a stun on Abscond/Abduct in four places. Riot's text for that ability describes a dash plus a recast chain pull with no stun, and the kit carries no hardCC flag for it, so the claim is removed rather than restated — if it does stun in game, the fix is to add it back with a source, not to leave an unsourced assertion on a paid page. The anti-heal advice in report[8] is genuinely correct here (Kingslayer heals), unlike several other Olaf pages, so it was left alone.
